# TabsPlacement

`Flare.Components.TabsPlacement`

Side of the content the FlareTabs bar is placed on.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Top` | `0` | Tab bar above the panels (horizontal). Default. |
| `Bottom` | `1` | Tab bar below the panels (horizontal). |
| `Left` | `2` | Tab bar to the left of the panels (vertical). |
| `Right` | `3` | Tab bar to the right of the panels (vertical). |

## Used by components

- `FlareTabs`
